toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Los 'n merk' copies English 'leave a mark'; standard Afrikaans is 'laat 'n merk'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Laat 'n merk' is the natural Afrikaans and the meaning, including 'soms', is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Dit los geen merk op die liggaam nie.
toegepas.na: Dit laat geen merk op die liggaam nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Same as in the previous block: 'laat 'n merk', not 'los 'n merk'; keeps the two blocks parallel.
toegepas.fout: 'los geen merk' copies English 'leave no mark'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same fix as change 2, keeps the two blocks parallel and says the same thing.

toegepas.na: kleineer hom of maak hom bang
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Maak hom klein' is a literal rendering of 'make him feel small'; 'kleineer' is the Afrikaans verb, and 'maak hom bang' stays.
toegepas.fout: 'maak hom klein' is a literal rendering of English 'make him feel small'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Kleineer' is the Afrikaans verb for this, 'maak hom bang' stays, and the protected opening 'Oor en oor skel iemand 'n kind uit' is untouched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma between the two verbs that end the relative clause and start the main clause aids reading; the protected words stay intact.
toegepas.fout: two verbs collide ('word slaap') where the relative clause ends, so a reader stumbles
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma marks the clause boundary and leaves the protected 'Sommige kinders wat mishandel word' intact.

toegepas.voor: Party voel baie bang en ander voel kwaad vir mense om hulle.
toegepas.na: Party voel baie bang, en ander voel kwaad vir die mense rondom hulle.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb; 'rondom hulle' is clearer than the ambiguous 'om hulle'.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have a subject and verb; bare 'mense om hulle' is slightly loose
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by the AWS rule, and 'vir die mense rondom hulle' keeps the same people and the same 'vir' while reading more clearly.

toegepas.blok: Dit is nooit die kind se skuld nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma between the two verbs where the relative clause ends and the main clause begins.
toegepas.fout: two verbs collide ('seermaak het') at the clause boundary
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma lets a Grade 5 reader see where the relative clause ends without changing a word.

toegepas.blok: Vertel dit vir iemand wat jy vertrou
toegepas.voor: jy vertrou soos 'n onderwyser of ouma
toegepas.na: jy vertrou, soos 'n onderwyser of 'n ouma
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without the comma 'soos' can be read as 'trust the way a teacher does'; the repeated article keeps the two examples parallel; the protected phrase stays intact.
toegepas.fout: without a comma 'soos' can be read as 'trust the way a teacher does'
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma and repeated article remove the misreading, the examples and the protected 'n volwassene wat jy vertrou' stay exactly as they are, and who to tell does not change.

toegepas.blok: Vertel dit vir iemand wat jy vertrou
toegepas.voor: wat jou bang maak is nie
toegepas.na: wat jou bang maak, is nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma between the two verbs at the end of the relative clause and the start of the main clause.
toegepas.fout: two verbs collide ('maak is') at the clause boundary
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma marks where the relative clause ends and changes nothing else.

toegepas.voor: te gaan se wat gebeur het
toegepas.na: te gaan sê wat gebeur het
toegepas.rede_vinder: The verb 'sê' needs its circumflex; 'se' is the possessive.
toegepas.fout: 'se' is the possessive; the verb needs its circumflex, 'sê'
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain spelling fix in a definition, with no change to the wording.

laat_vaar.voor: Mishandeling raak 'n kind se gesondheid en nie net sy liggaam nie.
laat_vaar.na: Mishandeling raak nie net 'n kind se liggaam nie, maar sy hele gesondheid.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The 'nie net ... maar' construction reads more naturally and avoids implying that the body is not part of health.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original reads clearly, and the proposal reorders it and adds 'hele', which is a lateral move with an added qualifier.

laat_vaar.voor: of bly van ander kinders af weg
laat_vaar.na: of bly weg van ander kinders
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Van ... af weg' is a clumsy double particle; 'bly weg van' is the natural form.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Van ander kinders af wegbly' is standard Afrikaans, and 'bly weg van' leans towards English 'stay away from'.

laat_vaar.blok: Dit is nooit die kind se skuld nie
laat_vaar.voor: stop te sit is die werk
laat_vaar.na: stop te sit, is die werk
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A comma after the long 'om ... te' subject clause, where two verbs meet.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The sentence is short and readable, and the parallel protected sentence 'Om dit verder te neem is die werk van grootmense soos' must stay without a comma, so adding one here makes the two sentences inconsistent.

laat_vaar.blok: Vertel dit vir iemand wat jy vertrou
laat_vaar.voor: gaan na 'n veilige plek of ander mense
laat_vaar.na: gaan na 'n veilige plek of na ander mense
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Repeating 'na' makes clear the child goes to other people, not to a place 'or other people'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: This is a safety instruction and the original already reads clearly as going to a safe place or to other people, so the extra 'na' is a lateral change to checked wording.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Iets privaat hou' copies English 'keep private'; 'vertroulik hou' is the standard Afrikaans and avoids 'geheim'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Privaat hou' is understood Afrikaans and plainer for Grade 5 than 'vertroulik', and the Childline privacy sentence is checked wording that should not shift.

na_skrywer.voor: so sleg dat dit hom skade doen
na_skrywer.na: so sleg dat dit hom skade aandoen
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The idiomatic verb with a person as object is 'iemand skade aandoen'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'hom skade doen' is less idiomatic than 'iemand skade aandoen'
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is fair, but this sentence echoes the kindermishandeling glossary definition word for word, so the writer should change both together or neither.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: laat hom voel hy is nie gewens nie
na_skrywer.na: laat hom voel niemand wil hom hê nie
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Nie gewens nie' copies English 'not wanted'; 'niemand wil hom hê nie' says the same in natural Grade 5 Afrikaans.
na_skrywer.fout: 'hy is nie gewens nie' is stiff and reads as translated from 'not wanted'
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The original falls short, but 'niemand wil hom hê nie' adds an absolute 'niemand' the original does not claim, so it needs another fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: With a person as object the idiom is 'skade aandoen'; 'aspris' stays.
na_skrywer.fout: 'n kind skade doen' is less idiomatic than 'n kind skade aandoen'
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar error, so only the writer may change it, for every lesson and for the matching study sentence in change 1.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Wanneer 'n grootmens of 'n ander kind 'n kind aspris skade doen.
vlae.rede: The study block also counts treating a child so badly that it harms him (no 'aspris') as abuse, so the glossary entry, read alone, is narrower than the lesson's own definition; that is a content question for the writer, not a language fix.
The title names only an adult, while the protected sentence in the first block says another child can do it too; the title may not be changed by this step, so it is flagged for the writer.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Moenie later teruggaan om die persoon daaroor aan te spreek of te stry nie, grootmens of kind
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'Stry' without a partner reads incompletely; natural Afrikaans is 'of met hom te stry'. Left unchanged because it is protected.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Om dit verder te neem is die werk van grootmense soos
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'Iets verder neem' is a calque of English 'take it further', and the sentence would normally take a comma before 'is'; both left unchanged because the wording is protected.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: As dit veilig is, mag jy 'Nee' sê en weggaan, ook vir 'n grootmens by die huis
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: This sentence writes 'Nee' quoted and capitalised, while the protected sentence two lines later writes 'nee sê' plainly; the two are inconsistent in one block, but both are protected.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Dan kan hulle 'n maatskaplike werker of die polisie inbring
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'Inbring' for involving people is close to English 'bring in'; 'betrek' or 'laat kom' would be more standard, but the wording is protected.
